reason: Avoid full Agent recovery for a source-validated idle history page while preserving every execution and mutation gate.
compatibility: New optional Store methods retain default fallbacks for other backends. Existing RPC shapes, journals, lightweight catalogues and recovery checkpoints are unchanged. A separate disposable bounded v1 presentation sidecar is source- and checksum-validated; absent, stale, oversized or corrupt acceleration takes the original recovery path. A validated checkpoint may seed only an identical source-bound idle catalogue without changing metadata or recovery flags. Native Windows replacement and restart gates remain mandatory in CI.
